name: energy-variational principle
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 由系统能量或功的变分建立运动及耦合关系的原理。
usage_overview: 用于车辆—轨道系统动力方程及动力矩阵的推导，通过系统能量与相关力的功的变分建立运动及耦合关系，所用表达包括弹性变形能和阻尼力做功。

complete_examples.text: Unlike most of the dynamic models, where the interconnections between the vehicle and the track entirely depend on the wheel–rail contact forces, the subsystems of the vehicle and the tracks in the present study are effectively united as an entire system with interactive matrices of stiffness, damping and mass by the energy-variational principle and wheel–rail contact geometry.

With an implementation of energy-variational principle d2Pd 1⁄4 0, where Pd is the total potential energy of an elastic system, d is the variation symbol and the subscript 2 represents the displacement or strain, and by referring to Ref. [31], the elastic potential energy produced in the suspension systems can be easily derived, and accordingly deduc-ing the matrices of the vehicle.

The dynamic matrices derived by the energy-variational principle will represent the linear components with constant system parameters [11], while the load vectors deduced by dynamic equilibriums are implemented to demonstrate the nonlinear characteristics of the coupled systems.

In this paper, a theoretical framework to effectively couple the railway wagon system and ballast-track system is presented by the energy-variational principle and dynamic equilibrium equations, through which a wagon-ballast track interaction model is developed to coordinate the linear and nonlinear system components.
Combining the energy-variational principle with the vehicle-bridge interaction (VBI) system, a new framework of train-track system space dynamics is constructed.

In this study, we draw essences from methodologies of refined wheel–rail coupling models and energy-variational principle, and a model for vehicle–track three-dimensional interactions with inclusion of rail irregularity excitations is newly developed.
